claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE starts a write transaction immediately or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY when another connection holds one.
RFC 3161 timestamp evidence establishes that a datum existed before a particular time, rather than establishing its exact creation time.
Local seal, plan, registration and first-view timestamps cannot alone prove generation after sealing; witnessing intent existence does not itself witness clip generation.
Pydantic 2.14 was released on 2026-10-08 and retains the documented exclusion of validation for copied updates.
SQLite 3.51.3 fixes a rare concurrent-WAL corruption race, with backports in 3.44.6 and 3.50.7, dated 2026-03-13.
RFC 9921, dated February 2026, standardizes COSE header parameters carrying RFC 3161 timestamp tokens while retaining their existence-before-time semantics.
C2PA 2.4, dated April 2026, section 18.15.4.3 distinguishes asserted action times from trusted timestamps attesting signature existence.
